sloka: नाम्ना च इयम् भगवतो दक्षिणा दिक् प्रदक्षिणा ।प्रथिता त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्धर्षा क्रूर कर्मभिः ॥३-११-८४॥
transliteration: nāmnā ca iyam bhagavato dakṣiṇā dik pradakṣiṇā ।prathitā triṣu lokeṣu durdharṣā krūra karmabhiḥ ॥3-11-84॥

translations.english: The southern side favourable to the people was famous by the name Agastya in the three worlds and stood unassailable to the demons.
